faq.q1q: What’s the difference between an IAD advisor and a traditional estate agency?
faq.q1a: An IAD real estate advisor is an independent professional attached to a network (IAD France). I offer the same services as an agency (valuation, sale, purchase) but with typically lower fees, because there is no high-street branch to maintain.
faq.q2q: How much does a property valuation cost in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q2a: The valuation is entirely free and comes with no commitment. It’s based on real recent sale prices in your area, combined with my on-the-ground knowledge of Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
faq.q3q: Which villages do you cover in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q3a: I cover the whole Provence Verte and Haut-Var area: Barjols, Montmeyan, Quinson, Fox-Amphoux, Tavernes, Rians, Aups, Salernes, Ginasservis, Varages, Esparron-de-Verdon, Artignosc-sur-Verdon and every neighbouring village.
faq.q4q: How long does it typically take to sell a property in Provence Verte?
faq.q4a: The average time depends on the property and its pricing. With an accurate valuation and a tailored marketing strategy, most properties in Provence Verte and Haut-Var find a buyer within 4 to 12 weeks.
faq.q5q: What is the express property audit?
faq.q5a: It’s a free review of your property, completed in a few minutes. It highlights the points to watch — legal, technical, environmental — so you can sell or buy with full clarity.
